title: Organization general chats
summary: Chats that work on every repository of an organization at once, with the agent, the index and the gate seeing all of them. In the organization's environment they are in the Chats item of the side menu, apart from the projects of each repository.
usage: In the organization's environment, click Chats in the side menu to open or close the list of general chats, newest first: click one to continue it or + to start another. The Open chat button at the top of Projects also lets you choose or start one. Without an organization folder on this computer, JayV asks for one first. In a general chat, the Repositories tab of the Code panel shows the git status of each repository of the folder and where its LLM policy comes from; the organization's repositories that are not in the folder show at the end. Also in the command palette (Ctrl+K): General chats. Before the first general chat, a window lists which repositories of the organization the chat sees: every clone found inside the folder counts, even one that is not a project on this computer.
